title: Meet Swift OpenAPI Generator
description: Discover how Swift OpenAPI Generator can help you work with HTTP server APIs whether you’re extending an iOS app or writing a server in Swift. We’ll show you how this package plugin can streamline your workflow and simplify your codebase by generating code from an OpenAPI document.

codeSnippets.title: Example OpenAPI document
codeSnippets.code:
openapi: "3.0.3"
info:
  title: "GreetingService"
  version: "1.0.0"
servers:
- url: "http://localhost:8080/api"
  description: "Production"
paths:
  /greet:
    get:
      operationId: "getGreeting"
      parameters:
      - name: "name"
        required: false
        in: "query"
        description: "Personalizes the greeting."
        schema:
          type: "string"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Returns a greeting"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Greeting"

codeSnippets.title: CatService openapi.yaml
codeSnippets.code:
openapi: "3.0.3"
info:
  title: CatService
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8080/api
    description: "Localhost cats 🙀"
paths:
  /emoji:
    get:
      operationId: getEmoji
      parameters:
      - name: count
        required: false
        in: query
        description: "The number of cats to return. 😽😽😽"
        schema:
          type: integer
      responses:
        '200':
          description: "Returns a random emoji, of a cat, ofc! 😻"
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string

        schema:
          type: integer
      responses:

              schema:

  /clip:

      operationId: getClip
      responses:

          description: "Returns a cat video! 😽"
          content:
            video/mp4:
              schema:
                type: string
                format: binary

resources.title: URLSession Transport for Swift OpenAPI Generator
resources.description:
A client transport that uses the URLSession type from the Foundation framework to perform HTTP operations.

Use the transport with client code generated by Swift OpenAPI Generator.
